_comment: Expected results for the pinned SDK version. /test-latest-sdk diffs each run against this file: a failure listed in knownFailures is expected, anything else is a new finding. Never add an entry to silence a new failure -- every entry needs a reason and a deferredUntil.

toolchainMinimums._comment: Node 22.18 is a hard requirement: below it there is no native TS type-stripping and test:node cannot run. Deno and Bun below minimum are reported SKIPPED, not failed.

resolvedDependencies._comment: The SDK pins js-xdr and axios exactly but uses ^ ranges elsewhere, so the same SDK version can resolve a different tree later.

runtimeAxis._comment: Live runs add 7 tests and remove the 1 placeholder that STELLAR_LIVE=0 substitutes, hence the 6-test delta. Node runs 1 test more than Bun because sdk-umd-bundle is Node-only.

coverage._comment: From coverage-audit.mjs. publicSymbols/backlog are the script's reported numbers; backlogTrue corrects for name-collision false positives found by reading the tests. Tiers 2-4 of the backlog are still open -- see ISSUES.md issue 7.

typeCheck._comment: 30 at 16.0.0; 3 fixed by getContractInstance typings, 0 new. 12 blocked on the js-xdr TS/ESM release, 9 residual SDK RPC-layer, 3 further SDK gaps, 3 harness-owned. See ISSUES.md issue 2.

expectedSurface._comment: Symbol counts the locks currently assert, versus what 16.2.0 actually exports. Diff by set difference, not by reading truncated assertion output: a truncated diff can hide a removal, and removals are breaking while additions are not.
